lines.en: label undeservedfuture3:
Ignoring how depressing and likely true that last line is, the camera fades to black as I turn my head to look behind me, searching for lighter footsteps to cut the darkness in two.
lines.zh: 姑且不去想最后那句话有多丧、又有多可能是真的——我转过头看向身后，画面随之淡出到黑，我在寻找那串更轻的脚步声，好把这片黑暗劈成两半。

lines.en: I find them and follow them home despite knowing the way there. It feels more real this way even when I know it’s not.
lines.zh: 我找到了它们，一路跟着回了家，尽管我认得路。这样走感觉更真实，哪怕我知道它并不真实。

lines.en: When I fall asleep tonight, I wonder what will happen.
lines.zh: 今晚入睡时，我想知道会发生什么。

lines.en: If there will be a dream within this dream that defies all odds and bequeaths unto me one more layer of undeserved happiness to mesh with that which I unknowingly claimed over the last fifteen years.
lines.zh: 会不会有梦中之梦，逆着一切概率，再赐给我一层我不配拥有的幸福，与这十五年来我在不知不觉间占据的那些交织在一起。

lines.en: If I do dream, I think it will be easier to make myself believe any of this life that feels far too good to be true, yet far too scary to {i}not{/i} be.
lines.zh: 如果我真的做梦了，我想那会更容易让自己相信这样的生活——好得不像真的，却又可怕得不容它{i}不是{/i}真的。

lines.en: There’s a light blue key strangled by braided metal in my pocket that I introduce to the lock of our door before pulling it open and finding out that home was never {i}nowhere{/i} at all.
lines.zh: 我口袋里有一把被编织金属缠得喘不过气的浅蓝色钥匙，我把它送进房门的锁里，然后拉开门，才发现家从来就不是{i}无处可寻{/i}。

lines.en: It was just a decade and a half away.
lines.zh: 它只是在一个半十年之外。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome1
: Okay! Now that I have been fed, I will leave you two to get back to whatever weird adult stuff you were doing before I came home! Just hopefully with less fainting this time.
lines.zh: : 好啦！既然我被喂饱了，我就不打扰你们继续做我回来之前在做的那些奇怪的大人事情了！只是希望这次少晕倒几次。

lines.en: : Are you going to bed already, Himawari? Isn’t it a little early?
lines.zh: : 你这就去睡了，Himawari？是不是有点早？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome2
: Bed? Oh, no. I just have a lot of homework to do. I’ll come say goodnight before I go to sleep.
lines.zh: : 睡觉？哦，不是。我只是有一大堆作业要写。睡前我会来跟你们说晚安的。

lines.en: : Why do your homework at all if you’re planning on dropping out and letting me home-school you?
lines.zh: : 既然你打算退学让我在家教你，那还写什么作业？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome3
: Akira...
lines.zh: : Akira……

lines.en: : What? She’s old enough to make her own decisions.
lines.zh: : 怎么？她已经到了能自己做决定的年纪了。

lines.en: : It’s that exact sentiment that ultimately spawned me in the first place! Great thinking as always, Dad! Or shall I say — Sensei?
lines.zh: : 正是这种想法，最终才有了我！一如既往地思路清奇，爸爸！还是我该叫你——Sensei？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome4
: Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 别这么叫。

lines.en: : Hima-chan, go do your homework. And never call your father “Sensei” again.
lines.zh: : Hima 酱，去做作业。还有永远别再叫你爸爸「Sensei」了。

lines.en: : I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome5
: But okay! Love you! Want me to start the bath? Or make tea or something?
lines.zh: : 不过好吧！爱你们！要我先放洗澡水吗？还是泡个茶什么的？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about us. Just...go to your room and {i}I’ll{/i} make some tea for all of us. Want me to bring it you?
lines.zh: : 别操心我们。你……回房间去，{i}我{/i}给咱们三个泡点茶。要我给你送过去吗？

lines.en: : Yes, please! This brain is not wider than the sky, but I will continue to work hard so that, one day, it might be!
lines.zh: : 好的，麻烦了！这颗脑子还没有天空那么宽广，但我会继续努力，总有一天它会是的！

lines.en: : {i}Oh! I want houjicha! And the creampuff I brought back from Beard Papa’s last night! It should still be good, I think! I hope!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦！我要焙茶！还有我昨晚从 Beard Papa's 带回来的泡芙！应该还能吃吧，我想！希望是！{/i}

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome6
: Stressed already, {i}darling?{/i} Did taking care of Ami for all those years not properly prepare you for {i}legitimate{/i} fatherhood?
lines.zh: : 已经开始有压力了，{i}亲爱的{/i}？照顾了 Ami 那么多年，还没让你做好当个{i}正经{/i}父亲的准备吗？

lines.en: : No, Ayane. That’s been like the main conflict in my character arc over the last couple years back in reality. Pay more attention.
lines.zh: : 没有，Ayane。那可是我在现实里这几年角色弧线的核心矛盾。你多上点心。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome7
: It was a joke, Akira. I know you do or...{i}did{/i} all you could for her, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的，Akira。我知道你为她做了……或者说{i}做过了{/i}你能做的一切吧。

lines.en: : Plus, you were like a dad to me too at first. Until you...impregnated me and dragged me all the way to Aomori.
lines.zh: : 再说，一开始你对我也像个爸爸。直到你……把我搞怀孕，还一路把我拽到了 Aomori。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome8
: Which I am obviously thankful for since it seems to have given us the chance to start over.
lines.zh: : 显然我很感激那件事，因为它似乎给了我们重新开始的机会。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome9
: So I guess what I’m saying is...there’s a pretty clear difference so far between the way you see Hima-chan and the way you saw your {i}first{/i} daughter.
lines.zh: : 所以我想说的是……到目前为止，你看待 Hima 酱的方式，和你看待你{i}第一个{/i}女儿的方式，差别相当明显。

lines.en: : Or {i}daughters{/i} depending on whether or not I count. Which I probably shouldn’t because, again, you bred me.
lines.zh: : 或者该说「{i}女儿们{/i}」——取决于我算不算一个。我大概不该算，因为说到底，是你把我搞大的。

lines.en: : If you’re done explaining your “joke” now, I would like to ask something. Assuming I am allowed, that is.
lines.zh: : 既然你解释完你的「玩笑」了，我想问个问题。当然，如果允许的话。

lines.en: : Of course, dearest husband. You are always free to speak your mind in our humble abode. I just hope it’s something happy this time.
lines.zh: : 当然，最亲爱的丈夫。在我们这间陋室里，你永远可以畅所欲言。我只是希望这次是开心的事。

lines.en: : Why do you think I left {i}her{/i} behind?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我为什么把{i}她{/i}抛下了？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome10
: Who, Ami? I’m...not really sure. We teleported here together, remember?
lines.zh: : 谁，Ami？我……不太确定。我们一起传送过来的，记得吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, just...I can’t really fathom how you getting pregnant would have spiraled into me abandoning her. And you apparently don’t have her number either, so-
lines.zh: : 是啊，只是……我实在想不通，你怀孕怎么会演变成我抛弃她。而且你显然也没有她的号码，所以——

lines.en: : Please don’t tell me you’re going to get hung up on her while we’re here. I’d like to keep all talks of incest out of this house, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 拜托别告诉我你在这儿还要对她念念不忘。我想让这栋房子里彻底没有乱伦的话题，非常感谢。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome11
: I’m not going to get {i}hung up.{/i} I’m just...
lines.zh: : 我不会{i}念念不忘{/i}的。我只是……

lines.en: : A lot of time has apparently gone by since we left Kumon-mi. Surely I’m not the only one who’s curious about how the others ended up, right?
lines.zh: : 我们离开 Kumon-mi 之后，显然已经过去很久了。总不会只有我一个人好奇其他人后来怎么样了吧？

lines.en: : I’m curious too, obviously. I just know better than to go chasing after what we chose to leave behind when what we {i}found{/i} is so much better.
lines.zh: : 我当然也好奇。我只是明白，既然我们{i}找到{/i}的已经好上这么多，就不该再去追那些我们当初选择抛下的东西。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome12
: Yeah...I guess you’re right. I’ll try not to bring it up anymore.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你说得对。我尽量不再提了。

lines.en: : You can bring it up, Akira. Just-
lines.zh: : 你可以提的，Akira。只是——

lines.en: : I’m going to head to the bedroom and try to unwind if that’s okay. With the exception of fainting earlier, I haven’t really slept since before I met Horseface Taki.
lines.zh: : 我想去卧室放松一下，可以吗？除了刚才晕倒那次，我从遇到 Horseface Taki 之前起就没怎么睡过觉。

lines.en: : Well...I’m sure it didn’t help that I slapped you out of the only bit of sleep you {i}have{/i} gotten, so...sure. Head off to bed and I’ll meet up with you in a few minutes. Do you want tea?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我把你{i}仅有{/i}的一点睡眠给打断了，肯定也没帮上什么忙，所以……好吧。你去睡吧，我过几分钟就去找你。要喝茶吗？

lines.en: : No thanks, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 不用了，Ayane。

lines.en: : A bath, perhaps?
lines.zh: : 那洗澡呢？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome13
: Or maybe...{i}me?{/i}
scene ayanehimahome14
: Or maybe...{i}me?{/i}
: I heard you the first time.
lines.zh: : 我第一次就听见了。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome15
: Then why didn’t you say anything? I offer you my voluptuous adult body and you remain silent? You were so excited earlier.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不说话？我把我成熟的性感身体送上门，你还沉默？你之前不是兴奋得很吗。

lines.en: : I still am. I just...feel weird about it while {i}she’s{/i} home.
lines.zh: : 我现在还是很兴奋。只是……{i}她{/i}在家，我总觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome16
: Akira...that’s adorable. This is the happiest I’ve ever been to have my advances refused.
lines.zh: : Akira……这太可爱了。这是我这辈子被拒绝得最开心的一次。

lines.en: : It is also the {i}only{/i} time I have ever had my advances refused.
lines.zh: : 这也是我有生以来{i}唯一{/i}一次被拒绝。

lines.en: : I figured I’d be more offended by that if it ever happened. But instead, I’m just proud to see how far you’ve come.
lines.zh: : 我原以为真有那么一天，我会更生气的。可结果我只是为你走了这么远而感到骄傲。

lines.en: : Talk to her please. About...{i}stuff.{/i} Just to see what she knows.
lines.zh: : 拜托你去跟她谈谈。关于……{i}那些事{/i}。就看看她知道些什么。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome17
: Yeah, yeah. {i}You want to bring back more than just misery{/i} and blah, blah, blah. Just go to the bedroom and I’ll meet up with you in a few. Okay?
lines.zh: : 好好好。{i}你想带回去的不只是痛苦{/i}，blah blah blah。你就先去卧室，我过会儿去找你。行吗？

lines.en: scene black
: ...Okay.
: And Ayane-
lines.zh: : 还有 Ayane——

lines.en: : What {i}now?{/i} I know I said you’re always free to speak your mind, but-
lines.zh: : {i}又{/i}怎么了？我知道我说过你永远可以畅所欲言，不过——

lines.en: : I just wanted to say I love you again.
lines.zh: : 我只是想再说一次我爱你。

lines.en: : That’s all. I- mmmnffff???
lines.zh: : 就这样。我——嗯唔唔？？？

lines.en: : Mmmmnncchu~
lines.zh: : 唔嗯啾～

lines.en: : You’re so cute now. I can’t believe you’re like 46.
lines.zh: : 你现在好可爱。真不敢信你都四十六了。

lines.en: : Me neither, to be honest. I saw myself in the mirror at the sushi restaurant and I really do look exactly the same.
lines.zh: : 说实话我也不敢信。我在寿司店的镜子里看到自己，真的跟以前一模一样。

lines.en: : Then, let’s hope that luck translates to me from now on as well! Aging is scary!
lines.zh: : 那希望这份运气从现在起也能分我一点！变老太可怕了！

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome18
: {i}Hima-chan? Can I come in?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Hima 酱？我能进来吗？{/i}

lines.en: : You don’t have to ask, Mom. I’ve told you a million times.
lines.zh: : 你不用问的，妈妈。我都说过一百万遍了。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome19
: Really? But you should be flooded by hormones at your age and-
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可你这个年纪应该正是荷尔蒙泛滥的时候，而且——

lines.en: : Can it. Whatever you’re about to say, I definitely don’t want to hear. Now, bring me my cream puff.
lines.zh: : 打住。不管你要说什么，我肯定都不想听。现在，把我的泡芙拿来。

lines.en: : You can have your cream puff in a minute. There’s actually something I want to talk to you about, if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 泡芙等一下再给你。其实我有件事想跟你谈谈，可以吗？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome20
: Something serious? Or something fun? Which Himawari should I be right now?
lines.zh: : 严肃的事？还是好玩的事？我现在该当哪个 Himawari？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome21
: It’s funny you should ask since that’s...kind of what I wanted to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 你这么问还真巧，因为那……正好就是我想跟你谈的。

lines.en: : You want to talk to me about me not knowing what you want to talk to me about?
lines.zh: : 你想跟我谈「我不知道你想跟我谈什么」这件事？

lines.en: : No. What? I want to talk to you about the potentiality of there actually being two Himawaris.
lines.zh: : 不是。什么？我想跟你谈的是，可能真的存在两个 Himawari。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. That makes way more sense.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那可合理多了。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome22
: Does it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. Do you have a secret drinking problem, Mom? Are you {i}using?{/i}
lines.zh: : 完全不是。妈妈，你是不是偷偷酗酒？你在{i}嗑药{/i}吗？

lines.en: : No, I am not {i}using.{/i} And I definitely don’t have a drinking problem. That would reflect poorly upon me as the nutritionist that I am. I just...
lines.zh: : 不，我没{i}嗑药{/i}。我也绝对没有酗酒的问题。那会有损我作为营养师的形象。我只是……

lines.en: : Listen — I know this is probably going to sound crazy. But there’s a reason your father and I were acting a little...{i}strange{/i} when you came home today.
lines.zh: : 听着——我知道这听起来大概很疯狂。但你今天回家的时候，你爸爸和我表现得有点……{i}奇怪{/i}，是有原因的。

lines.en: : Again, whatever you’re about to say, I definitely don’t want to hear. What you and Dad do when I’m not home is between you guys. I have nothing to do with it.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，不管你要说什么，我肯定都不想听。你和爸爸在我没在家的时候做什么，那是你们之间的事。跟我没关系。

lines.en: : It’s not like that, Himawari. We were just...
lines.zh: : 不是那样的，Himawari。我们只是……

lines.en: : We were taking a nap. And we both had a really strange dream. The {i}same{/i} dream. And you were in it.
lines.zh: : 我们在睡午觉。然后我们俩都做了一个很奇怪的梦。{i}同一个{/i}梦。而你在梦里。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome23
: A dream?
: He and I were younger...and back in the town we grew up in. You know, the one we won’t let you visit.
lines.zh: : 他和我都更年轻……而且回到了我们长大的那座小镇。就是那个我们不让你去的小镇。

lines.en: : Yeah. Rub it in, why don’t you?
lines.zh: : 是啊。你就使劲往我伤口上撒盐吧。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome24
: For some reason, everyone else in the dream disappeared. All of our friends...family...they were all just gone. And it was only your dad and me until {i}you{/i} showed up.
lines.zh: : 不知为什么，梦里其他所有人都消失了。我们所有的朋友……家人……他们全都不见了。在{i}你{/i}出现之前，就只有你爸爸和我。

lines.en: : But neither one of us recognized you. Or...I guess {i}I{/i} technically recognized you. But I didn’t know {i}who{/i} you were.
lines.zh: : 但我们俩都没认出你。或者……严格来说{i}我{/i}算是认出了你。可我不知道你是{i}谁{/i}。

lines.en: : And you and I were about the same age in the dream, so of course I wasn’t going to assume you were my {i}daughter.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而且梦里你和我年纪差不多，所以我当然不会以为你是我{i}女儿{/i}。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome25
: But anyway, you showed up, and you basically told us that we were going to die if we didn’t do exactly as you said.
lines.zh: : 总之，你出现了，然后基本上告诉我们，如果不照你说的做，我们就会死。

lines.en: : We were a little hesitant at first, but...not having any other options, we decided to stake everything on you.
lines.zh: : 一开始我们有点犹豫，不过……没有别的选择，我们决定把一切都押在你身上。

lines.en: : So you opened up a magical door and told us we’d be safe as long as we walked through it. That you’d come and get us once the apocalypse ended.
lines.zh: : 于是你打开了一扇魔法门，告诉我们只要穿过去就会安全。你说等末日结束就来接我们。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome26
: So we did. And all of a sudden, we were here.
lines.zh: : 我们就照做了。然后一转眼，我们就到了这里。

lines.en: : Crazy dream, right?
lines.zh: : 很疯狂的梦，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s crazy, Mom. I think it’s sweet. And pretty accurate too since I’d definitely find a way to spare you guys from the apocalypse if one were to ever happen.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不疯狂啊，妈妈。我觉得很温馨。而且还挺准确的——因为如果真有末日，我肯定会想办法让你们躲过去的。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome27
: I guess that sort of explains that whole “traveled through time” thing you said about me earlier too. That was super weird without context, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 我想这大概也解释了你们之前说我会「穿越时间」那件事。说实话，没有上下文的话那听着怪死了。

lines.en: : Hima-chan, do you know anything about the world resetting? Or interdimensional travel or magical doors or {i}anything{/i} like that? {i}At all?{/i}
lines.zh: : Hima 酱，你知不知道世界重置之类的事？或者跨次元旅行、魔法门{i}什么的{/i}？{i}一点{/i}都不知道吗？

lines.en: : No more than the next girl. Was your dream really that believable?
lines.zh: : 不比一般女孩知道得多。你那个梦真的那么可信吗？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome28
: {i}Believable{/i} would be an understatement. But I {i}will{/i} tell you that it feels more like a nightmare in retrospect. Especially after seeing all I have here.
lines.zh: : 说{i}「可信」{/i}都算轻描淡写了。不过我{i}可以{/i}告诉你，现在回想起来，那更像是一场噩梦。尤其是在看到我在这里拥有的一切之后。

lines.en: : Is that really all you wanted to talk to me about? Just...to confirm I’m not a secret alien version of your daughter who swapped places with the real one or something?
lines.zh: : 你找我就真的只为这件事？就……为了确认我不是什么偷偷跟真正的女儿调包的外星人版本？

lines.en: : I told you it was going to sound crazy.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，这听起来会很疯狂。

lines.en: : Yeah, well you sure didn’t disappoint.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你还真没让我失望。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome29
: This is the kind of stuff I’d expect from Dad, though. Not you, Mom. Is he the one who put you up to this?
lines.zh: : 不过这种事我本来以为会是爸爸问的。没想到是你，妈妈。是他让你来的吗？

lines.en: : I’d call it a...{i}joint{/i} decision, if anything. He {i}is{/i} worried, though.
lines.zh: : 要我说的话……算是{i}共同{/i}决定吧。不过他{i}确实{/i}很担心。

lines.en: : He’s not used to being this happy. So any opportunity he gets to believe the rug is about to be pulled out from underneath his feet, he takes it. No questions asked.
lines.zh: : 他不习惯这么幸福。所以只要有机会让他相信脚下的地毯马上就要被抽走，他就会毫不犹豫地抓住。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome30
: He’s gonna be okay, right? Because I tried to keep it together, but I got pretty freaked out when he fainted earlier and-
lines.zh: : 他会没事的，对吧？因为我一直努力装作没事，但他刚才晕倒的时候我真的吓坏了，而且——

lines.en: : He’ll be fine...I think your cuteness just sent him into shock for a little while.
lines.zh: : 他会没事的……我觉得是你的可爱劲儿让他一时休克了。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome31
: Can I...ask you something too, Mom? Something demonstrably {i}less{/i} crazy but also {i}a little{/i} crazy in the fact that it seems sort of...reckless in a sense?
lines.zh: : 我……也能问你件事吗，妈妈？明显{i}没那么{/i}疯狂，但又{i}有点{/i}疯狂——因为它在某种意义上显得挺……鲁莽的？

lines.en: : Of course you can. Whatever it is, you can ask away.
lines.zh: : 当然可以。不管是什么，尽管问。

lines.en: : I was serious earlier, you know.
lines.zh: : 我之前是认真的，你知道的。

lines.en: : About dropping out...
lines.zh: : 关于退学……

lines.en: : And I don’t think I really got that across the way I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得我没能把自己真正想表达的说清楚。

lines.en: : Is something going on at school that gave you this idea, Hima-chan? Why do you want to drop out?
lines.zh: : 学校里发生了什么让你有这个想法吗，Hima 酱？你为什么想退学？

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I worry about him.
lines.zh: : 我担心他。

lines.en: : And with you working and {i}me{/i} in school all the time, I...
lines.zh: : 你一直在上班，{i}我{/i}也一直在上学，我……

lines.en: : I just don’t want him to feel lonely.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让他觉得孤单。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome32
: Plus, it’s not like I’m ever really {i}learning{/i} anything in school to begin with.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我在学校本来就什么都没真正{i}学到{/i}。

lines.en: : Like, even my AP classes are laughably easy. So it’s like, what am I even doing there? Wouldn’t I be better off {i}here{/i} instead? With a custom-made curriculum?
lines.zh: : 就连我的 AP 课程都简单得可笑。所以我就想，我到底在那儿干什么？我在{i}这里{/i}不是更好吗？用专门为我定制的课程？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome33
: You’re really serious about this?
lines.zh: : 你是真的认真吗？

lines.en: : I am. And I know I’m young. But when {i}you{/i} were my age, you-
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。我知道我还小。但{i}你{/i}在我的年纪的时候，你——

lines.en: : You don’t need to remind me what {i}I{/i} did when I was your age.
lines.zh: : 你不用提醒我{i}我{/i}在你这个年纪做过什么。

lines.en: : Just...please don’t follow in my footsteps. Your father doesn’t even like it when boys {i}look{/i} at you. The last thing he needs is worrying about you getting pregnant.
lines.zh: : 只是……求你别步我的后尘。你爸爸连男生多{i}看{/i}你一眼都不乐意。他最不需要的，就是再操心你会不会怀孕。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome34
: What a coincidence! That’s the last thing {i}I{/i} need as well. And one more reason why it would be beneficial to homeschool me as no boys would even get to {i}look{/i} at me. We all win.
lines.zh: : 真巧！那也是{i}我{/i}最不需要的。这也是在家上学对我有好处的又一个理由——因为那样连男生都{i}看不到{/i}我。大家都赢。

lines.en: : Hima-chan...would that {i}really{/i} make you happy, though? Or is all of this for his-
lines.zh: : Hima 酱……可这{i}真的{/i}会让你开心吗？还是说这一切都是为了他——

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome35
: This is where I want to be, Mom.
lines.zh: : 我想待的就是这里，妈妈。

lines.en: : Trust me.
lines.zh: : 相信我。

lines.en: : Well...
: Trusting you hasn’t let me down yet, so...
lines.zh: : 相信你到现在还没让我失望过，所以……

lines.en: scene black
: Let me talk to your father and we can figure out where to go from there.
lines.zh: : 让我跟你爸爸谈谈，我们再看看接下来怎么办。

lines.en: : Really?! You’ll consider it?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！你们会考虑吗？！

lines.en: : We’ll {i}consider{/i} it. No promises, though. Because I have seen your father teach firsthand and, bless his heart, but he is the {i}worst{/i} teacher in the entire world.
lines.zh: : 我们会{i}考虑{/i}。不过不保证。因为我亲眼见过你爸爸教书，上帝保佑他，但他绝对是全世界{i}最烂{/i}的老师。

lines.en: : Don’t worry! I’ll cancel that out as the best student! And after that, we- wait, where’s my tea?
lines.zh: : 别担心！我会以最好的学生身份把这点抵消掉的！然后我们——等等，我的茶呢？

lines.en: : Oh, I haven’t made it yet. I got distracted by our bonding.
lines.zh: : 哦，我还没泡呢。我们聊得太投入，我给忘了。

lines.en: : Mom! I would have just made it on my own if I knew you were going to forget!
lines.zh: : 妈妈！早知道你会忘，我自己泡就好了！

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome36
: Well, Akira, I think it’s safe to say that our daughter is {i}not{/i} a time-traveler.
lines.zh: : 好了，Akira，我想可以肯定地说，我们的女儿{i}不是{/i}时间旅行者。

lines.en: : Or at least...isn’t one yet? I’ve never really understood how any of that stuff works, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 或者至少……现在还不是？说实话，我从来没真正搞懂那些东西是怎么回事。

lines.en: : You don’t think she was just lying to you?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得她只是在对你撒谎吗？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome37
: Frankly, I’m not yet convinced she knows how to lie. Every single interaction I have had with her since we woke up here has only made me fall deeper in love with her.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我还不能确信她会不会说谎。自从我们在这里醒来，我和她的每一次互动，都只让我更深地爱上她。

lines.en: : It’s almost like she’s too good to be true...isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 简直像是好得不像真的……不是吗？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome38
: Do you know what she just told me, Akira? Do you know what her reason for wanting to drop out of school is?
lines.zh: : 你知道她刚跟我说了什么吗，Akira？你知道她想退学的理由是什么吗？

lines.en: : Oh, was she serious about that?
lines.zh: : 哦，她那事是认真的？

lines.en: : She wants to be here with {i}you{/i} because she’s worried you’ll feel lonely without us.
lines.zh: : 她想待在这里陪{i}你{/i}，因为她担心没有我们你会觉得孤单。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome39
: Turns out I was right about our genes combining to form the actual perfect human being. I completely understand why we stopped at one instead of a whole football team now.
lines.zh: : 看来我说对了——我们的基因组合成了真正完美的人类。我现在完全理解为什么我们只生了一个，而不是凑出一整支橄榄球队。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome40
: What did you tell her?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么跟她说的？

lines.en: : About being homeschooled? That we’d talk about it. Because {i}you’re{/i} the one who would have to teach her. Which would mean that {i}you’re{/i} the one responsible for-
lines.zh: : 关于在家上学？我说我们会商量。因为要教她的人{i}是你{/i}。也就是说，要为这件事负责的{i}是{/i}——

lines.en: : I know exactly what it means. Teaching’s the only job I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: : 我完全知道那意味着什么。教书是我这辈子唯一干过的工作。

lines.en: : Right, which is why I’m trying to give you a rundown of it because the way you taught {i}me{/i} is not good enough for Himawari. You will need to be better.
lines.zh: : 对，所以我才想给你讲讲清楚——因为你教{i}我{/i}的那套对 Himawari 来说远远不够。你得做得更好。

lines.en: : Do you think I {i}can,{/i} Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我{i}能做到{/i}吗，Ayane？

lines.en: : I think you can for {i}her.{/i} And I know it’s only been a little while, but I can’t imagine you’d ever put her in harm’s way. What sort of impact will it have on {i}you,{/i} though?
lines.zh: : 我觉得为了{i}她{/i}你能做到。我知道才过了这么一会儿，但我想象不出你会把她置于险境。不过这对{i}你自己{/i}会有什么影响呢？

lines.en: : It’s been years since you properly taught. In both our world {i}and{/i} this new one.
lines.zh: : 你已经好多年没正经教过书了。无论是在我们的世界，{i}还{/i}是这个新世界。

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I’m too tired and still a little too shocked to even imagine it right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在太累了，也还是有点太震惊，根本没法去想象。

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome41
: Well, on a scale of one to ten, how {i}tired{/i} would you say that you are?
lines.zh: : 那么，一分到十分，你觉得自己有多{i}累{/i}？

lines.en: : Does the answer to this question determine whether or not we’re having sex?
lines.zh: : 这个问题的答案决定了我们做不做爱吗？

lines.en: scene ayanehimahome42
: No. It {i}does{/i} determine the position, though. And whether or not I’ll need to tape your mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 不。不过它{i}决定{/i}了姿势。还有我需不需要把你的嘴贴上胶带。

lines.en: : You’re the loud one. Shouldn’t we be taping {i}your{/i} mouth shut if anything?
lines.zh: : 叫得大声的是你吧。真要贴也该贴{i}你的{/i}嘴吧？

lines.en: : If that’s what turns you on, sure.
lines.zh: : 如果那能让你兴奋，那就这么办。

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : It just...feels {i}weird{/i} knowing she’s right down the hall and-
lines.zh: : 只是……想到她就在走廊那头，总觉得{i}怪怪的{/i}，而且——

lines.en: : If you’re worried about her hearing us, she put her headphones on as soon as I left the room. And I told her I’d convey her “goodnight” message to you, so...
lines.zh: : 如果你担心她听见，我一离开房间她就戴上耳机了。而且我跟她说了我会把她的「晚安」转达给你，所以……

lines.en: : I think it’s safe to say we won’t be interrupted, {i}darling.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我想可以放心地说，我们不会被打断了，{i}亲爱的{/i}。

lines.en: : Come on, {i}Akira.{/i} We jumped fifteen years into the future. Having sex with me right now only seems fair seeing as we had to skip over whatever happened during our honeymoon, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 来嘛，{i}Akira{/i}。我们一下子跳到了十五年后。既然我们连蜜月都跳过去了，现在跟我做爱不是很公平吗？

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : I will ask you again — on a scale of cowgirl to backwards spider crawl, how {i}fucking{/i} tired are you?
lines.zh: : 我再问你一次——从女上位到倒着蜘蛛爬，你{i}他妈{/i}到底有多累？
